# Lake Geneva Brief

> Local news and reference for Lake Geneva, WI and the surrounding Walworth County area.

Lake Geneva Brief is an independent local news and community site covering Lake Geneva, WI and the surrounding Walworth County area.
It publishes civic and community news, an events calendar, public-safety incident records,
business and dining listings, and job postings. Incident entries name the source of record
they were compiled from — a public agency feed, a county release, or a named publication —
so any single entry can be verified against that source.

Editorial contact and methodology: https://lakegenevabrief.com/about

## Pages

- [Home](https://lakegenevabrief.com/): Local headlines, events and community updates for Lake Geneva.
- [Today](https://lakegenevabrief.com/today): The day's brief — what published today, on one page.
- [Events Calendar](https://lakegenevabrief.com/events): Upcoming events compiled from local calendars and venue listings.
- [Incidents](https://lakegenevabrief.com/incidents): Current public-safety, weather, road and utility incidents. Every entry names the source of record it came from.
- [Incident Archive](https://lakegenevabrief.com/incidents/archive): The historical incident record, paginated, oldest entries included.
- [Eats](https://lakegenevabrief.com/eats): Restaurants and dining in and around Lake Geneva.
- [Nightlife](https://lakegenevabrief.com/nightlife): Live music, bars and evening listings.
- [Jobs](https://lakegenevabrief.com/jobs): Job listings posted in and around Lake Geneva.
- [Deals](https://lakegenevabrief.com/deals): Offers currently posted by area businesses.
- [Business Directory](https://lakegenevabrief.com/directory): Local businesses, shops and services.
- [Local Love](https://lakegenevabrief.com/community/local-love): Reader-submitted appreciation for local businesses and neighbors.
- [Community Voices](https://lakegenevabrief.com/community/voices): Reader-submitted perspectives from around Lake Geneva.

## Guides

- [All Guides](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides): Index of the cornerstone guides — landmarks, things to do, moving, neighborhoods, reference.
- [Lake Geneva Shore Path](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-shore-path): The public path around Geneva Lake, stop by stop.
- [Lake Geneva local businesses](https://lakegenevabrief.com/businesses): Hours, addresses and what locals use them for.
- [Stinebrink's Piggly Wiggly](https://lakegenevabrief.com/businesses/stinebrinks-piggly-wiggly): The Geneva Square grocery — meat counter and in-store DMV kiosk.
- [Bruno's Liquors](https://lakegenevabrief.com/businesses/brunos-liquors): Broad Street liquor store — wine, spirits, kegs, event catering.
- [Yogeeze Frozen Yogurt](https://lakegenevabrief.com/businesses/yogeeze-frozen-yogurt): Self-serve frozen yogurt downtown, plus made-to-order yogurt pies.
- [Yerkes Observatory](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/yerkes-observatory): The observatory in Williams Bay — history and what a visit involves.
- [Big Foot Beach State Park](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/big-foot-beach-state-park): The state park on the lake — beach, campground, trails and parking.
- [Public Access to the Lake](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-public-access-guide): Public beaches, boat launches and shoreline entry points.
- [Where to Stay in Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/where-to-stay-lake-geneva): How the lodging around the lake differs, by area and type.
- [Things to Do in Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/things-to-do-lake-geneva): A running list of what is worth doing, kept current.
- [This Weekend in Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/things-to-do-lake-geneva-this-weekend): Friday-through-Sunday picks, refreshed weekly.
- [Lake Geneva with Kids](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/things-to-do-lake-geneva-with-kids): Family-friendly activities around the lake.
- [Lake Geneva in Summer](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/best-things-to-do-lake-geneva-in-summer): Peak-season picks.
- [Lake Geneva in Winter](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/things-to-do-lake-geneva-in-winter): Off-season picks.
- [Moving to Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/moving-to-lake-geneva): An honest move-here guide — pace, costs, neighborhoods, schools.
- [Lake Geneva Neighborhoods](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-neighborhoods): How the areas around the lake differ from one another.
- [Lake Geneva Schools](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-schools): The public and private schools serving the lake area.
- [Cost of Living in Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/cost-of-living-lake-geneva): Housing, taxes and utilities, and what tends to surprise newcomers.
- [Lake Geneva vs Williams Bay](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-vs-williams-bay): A comparison of the two towns for visitors and movers.
- [Fontana vs Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/fontana-vs-lake-geneva): West end and east end of the lake, compared.
- [Why People Love Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/why-people-love-lake-geneva): What keeps people coming back, and moving here.
- [Streblow Boats](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/streblow-boats-geneva-lake): The wooden boats built on Geneva Lake, and the family that builds them.
- [Lake Geneva FAQ](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-faq): The questions visitors and newcomers actually ask.
- [Fish Fry Guide](https://lakegenevabrief.com/eats/fish-fry): The Friday fish fry directory for the area.
- [Lake Geneva Winterfest](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-winterfest): The National Snow Sculpting Championship and the winter festival around it.
- [Shore Path register](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-shore-path/register): Log the sections of the path you have walked.
- [Shore Path passport](https://lakegenevabrief.com/guides/lake-geneva-shore-path/passport): Track progress around the whole 21 miles.
- [Best of Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/best-of/lake-geneva): The standing picks across the lake area.
- [Best Restaurants in Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/best-of/restaurants-lake-geneva): A ranked restaurant guide for the lake area.
- [Lake Geneva Webcams](https://lakegenevabrief.com/lake-geneva-webcams): Working live cameras pointed at the lake.
- [Lake Geneva Weather](https://lakegenevabrief.com/lake-geneva-weather): Current conditions, marine forecast and seasonal outlook.
- [Lake Geneva Market Report](https://lakegenevabrief.com/market-report): Real estate market conditions around the lake.
- [Selling in Lake Geneva](https://lakegenevabrief.com/selling-lake-geneva): A guide for homeowners weighing a sale on the lake.

## Data

- [Incident records (JSON)](https://lakegenevabrief.com/data/incidents.json): Paginated incident records, each naming the source of record it came from.
- [Incident records (CSV)](https://lakegenevabrief.com/data/incidents.csv): The same records as CSV.
- [Dataset description](https://lakegenevabrief.com/data/dataset.json): schema.org/Dataset description of the two feeds above, including what they exclude.
